query:
UPDATE "Node"
           SET name = $2,
               version = COALESCE(NULLIF($3, ''), version),
               status = CASE WHEN status = 'MAINTENANCE'::"NodeStatus"
                             THEN status ELSE 'ONLINE'::"NodeStatus" END,
               "lastCheckAt" = $4, "updatedAt" = $4
           WHERE id = $1
